text: yeah so back on that thread this thing what the fuck am i looking at here what is that triple beam nightmare on the end of t his thing [Image #13]
resolution: Removed the 'triple beam' icon column from the menu-bar dropdown rows (DropdownMenu.tsx MenuRow). Every row ended with three cryptic unlabeled ~9px icon dots driven by command flags — context (MousePointerClick icon), native (Cpu icon), and undoable (History icon) — i.e. raw engineer-facing command metadata dumped onto a user-facing File/Edit/View menu. To someone opening a menu, three mystery indicators after each shortcut convey nothing; whether a command is context-sensitive, host-native, or undoable is implementation detail the code consumes, not menu copy. A menu item is now just its icon + name + right-aligned shortcut. The context/native/undoable flags remain on the Command records in data/commands.ts (the logic still uses them for undo, context menus, behavior) — only their cryptic per-row visualization was cut. HW_CheckCell/HW_CheckCellOff are now unused but left in workspace.cls (harmless style entries). This also resolves the earlier 'inline keybinding pow-wow' confusion: there was no rebind mechanism in the menu — these read-only metadata badges were what read as a clownshow. Parses clean via esbuild transform; not shipped (live session). Sha 1d48d6b91.
